title: Youth programs that reported the same counts two years running
question: Did any program report exactly the same participant days in both years, as a figure copied forward would?
finding: Of 252 programs with pages for both years, 2 reported the same participant days in both: Flyaway Productions - Girlfly (same participants, service dates, participant service dates; 300 days); Embarcadero YMCA - Treasure Island Out of School Time Programs (same participant service dates; 4,656 days).
how: Participants, service dates and participant days on the 2024-25 and 2025-26 pages of the same program (matched by the program title).
limits: A small program with a fixed roster and calendar (20 places, 16 sessions) can honestly repeat its counts; a repeat is a question for the department, not a finding.

rows.same: participants, service dates, participant service dates

rows.program: Embarcadero YMCA - Treasure Island Out of School Time Programs

sources.t: Department of Children, Youth and Their Families: Grantee Year End Reports 2024-29, all program, service-area and strategy pages, 2024-25 and 2025-26 (saved 21 November 2026)
